goal: Add three independent text helpers, each with its own module and tests, and document them in the README.

alternatives.title: One module per helper, re-exported from src/index.js
tradeoffs: Each helper can be owned and tested by an independent task, so three workers can run in parallel without touching the same file.
Slightly more files than a single utils module.
Matches the existing capitalize.js layout, so nothing about the package shape has to change.

alternatives.title: A single src/text.js exporting all three helpers
tradeoffs: Fewer files and one import site.
All three helpers share one file, so the work cannot be split across parallel tasks without two workers editing the same file.
Breaks the existing one-helper-per-file convention set by capitalize.js.

self_critique.weakest_point: truncate's ellipsis rule is ambiguous at the boundary: whether max counts the ellipsis characters is not stated, and an off-by-one there is the most likely defect.
self_critique.cut_or_change: State in the acceptance criteria that max is the length of the returned string including the ellipsis, and require a test at exactly the boundary length.
